Published paper and verification package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23430326 (https://zenodo.org/records/23430326).

This attributed mathematical note gives a complete checkable proof for F=Q3 and its unramified quadratic extension E: the GL15 Langlands quotient with segments [4,6],[2,5],[3,3],[1,4],[0,2] is tau invariant, is not an entire proper parabolic induction, and has no unitary-stabilizer period for either Hermitian isometry class. The total is zero instead of two in the historical OWR14/2011 Conjecture4 k=1 smooth-complex p-adic interpretation. The same example contradicts FLO Conjecture6.12 and the unrestricted local unitary Jacquet converse; it does not contradict generic or tempered positive results.

FLO supplies the complete period bases, normalization, functional equations and adjacent-label exclusion. JPSS supplies segment L-factors; Lapid-Minguez supplies classification, ladder-side matching, involution and prior kernel transport. Gurevich-Ma-Mitra and Mitra-Offen-Sayag supply earlier imprimitive negative-distinction and quotient-descent antecedents for different subgroups. Beuzart-Plessis and Lu-Matringe receive credit for established generic/tempered results; Sharma for a different five-segment combinatorial comparison.

Historical priority and every substantive overlap comparison with Luo-Zha, A Remark on Bernstein-Zelevinsky Classification for General Linear Groups, DOI10.1007/s11464-025-0256-0, are UNKNOWN. Their complete body was unavailable and uninspected. Their documented earlier kernel-generation counterexample claim is credited. This note may overlap or be superseded by it. No worldwide novelty, firstness, current-open-status or separate kernel-generation disproof claim is made.

AI tools were used extensively in construction, source comparison, adversarial checks, computations and writing. This is unrefereed, without external human peer review, journal acceptance or proof-assistant certification. The standard-library exact verification kit corroborates finite identities and conditions; the written argument and published theorem dependencies establish the representation-theoretic conclusion. Authored text and code are CC BY4.0.

## Accepted scope and review For Q3 and its unramified quadratic extension, the GL15 five-segment Langlands quotient is tau-invariant and noninduced with both unitary periods zero; k=1 proposed total 2 is replaced by 0. Luo-Zha DOI10.1007/s11464-025-0256-0 full body unavailable and uninspected; exact, transformed, dual, twist, kernel and unitary overlap comparisons remain UNKNOWN. The result may overlap or be superseded. No novelty, firstness, worldwide current openness or separate kernel-generation disproof is asserted. The result is accepted at the exact audited head `810d52306312623ecfe01ecbc5f5f0dd360972c3`. 2 fresh independent complete AI whole-package reviews were completed, with the final review finding zero actionable issues. Subsequent bounded administrative adoption is recorded in the current external ROOT final seal; earlier status/counter/hold fields remain dated history. Prior mathematical results and proof dependencies are credited. Historical novelty and worldwide current openness are unestablished. AI tools were used extensively; this is an unrefereed preprint, without conventional human peer review or formal proof certification. The repository Zenodo uploader verified the exact reviewed metadata and PDF/support bytes. The Google Workspace CLI recorded the DOI/details in the requested tracker with exact read-back. No GitHub release is created. Current audit and publication receipts: `audits/pr1032_30001739`.
Preserved original PR description: dated submission history ## Result and exact scope Publish the complete five-segment counterexample and its full independent audit plus separate narrow analytic audit for problem 30001739. Disposition: **ACCEPTED_COMPLETE_COUNTEREXAMPLE** in the documented characteristic-zero p-adic smooth admissible complex scope. This is AI-assisted mathematical-audit acceptance, not conventional human peer review or journal acceptance. For F=Q_3 and its unramified quadratic extension E, let pi be the Langlands quotient of the GL_15(E) standard module with ordered segments [4,6], [2,5], [3,3], [1,4], [0,2]. It is tau-invariant and noninduced (not itself an entire proper parabolic induction). For k=1, both Hermitian-form multiplicities vanish, so the target's total is **0 rather than 2**. The proof uses complete 16-element Hom bases in three orders, holomorphic invertible transports for the two nested swaps, and necessary linked-pair coefficient constraints forming E-D-B-A-C-E. Noninducedness is certified by all **15** exact singleton Hall obstructions, with a ladder side in every partition. The highest-risk analytic steps passed the separate audit. FLO equation (4.5) is corrected to printed **p.225**; the rank-one kernel is explicitly the kernel of **unnormalized forward M**, equal to the image of **reverse normalized N**. General maximal-kernel generation is not used. The multiplicity conclusion depends on the cited published FLO, JPSS and LM theorems. The finite scripts do not compute Hom spaces. ## Literature and attribution The same accepted vanishing also contradicts FLO Conjecture 6.12 (p.246), since the individually tau-invariant Langlands data have tau-Witt index zero by FLO pp.214–215. This is a same-scope consequence, not a separate independent-discovery claim. [FLO published record](https://doi.org/10.1007/s10240-012-0040-z). A bounded 50-query literature comparison verified no exact or translated/twisted-equivalent predecessor and no contrary established theorem. **Priority remains unestablished.** Luo–Zha's related kernel-generation counterexample was announced in the [May 13, 2025 workshop program](https://hkumath.hku.hk/MathWWW/event/2025/Workshop_Program.pdf) and [published online July 5, 2026](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11464-025-0256-0). Their full paper remains uninspected: neither exact duplication nor unrelatedness is asserted. No all-local-fields or novelty claim is made. ## Contents and limits This is an additive, target-only 44-file source-free delivery under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30001739/`: - Current complete proof, contextual corrections, both full mathematical audit reports, diagnostic-validation narrative, exact target model, and all 15 Hall certificates. - Four complete finite checkers: authored set-based Hall and scalar/parity checks, full independent audit checks, and separate exact-rational scalar checks of all 10 pairs at q=3,9 and both signs (40 rows; 30 order conditions). - Public-only citation/PDF-hash/inspection metadata and the bounded priority report, public search history and match results. - Isolated replay adapter, full raw mode-specific reference outputs, strict manifest/verifier, actual finite mutants and separately categorized publication controls. No source PDFs or source text, dataset contents, private sources, private coordination, identifying metadata for excluded private files, wholesale source archives, or full superseded provisional proof are included. All 173 original files remain unchanged. The author is frozen at 2/5 proof approaches; no new proof approach is introduced by publication. `QUEUE.md` and all unrelated repository content are unchanged. ## Fresh verification Normal Python, -O and -OO each passed as actual UID/EUID1000 with files 0444 and packet directories 0555: - 4 positive full-output finite checker runs and 6 actual mathematical algorithm/hypothesis source mutants, all rejected for their intended exact reasons. - Separately: 61 integrity mutations, 77 strict-schema/scope controls and 34 direct output-comparator controls. - 48 actual denied-write probes per mode, requiring PermissionError/errno13. - Complete stdout/stderr byte equality and recursively exact JSON identities, counts, types and reasons; no normalization or PASS-only acceptance. Exact captured inner checker streams are retained verbatim with byte counts/hashes and compared against fixed references, alongside the entire raw adapter output. Strict inner parsing rejects duplicate keys, nonfinite/overflow values, malformed JSON and trailing content. - Targeted outer and direct-inner controls reject whitespace-only changes and duplicate-key JSON yielding the same ordinarily decoded object; these are publication-validation controls, separate from mathematical mutations. - Hostile-import complete-baseline output equality, with no hostile sentinel and unchanged whole-delivery before/after hashes. - A held-out fresh `git apply` of the exact additive diff reproduced every delivered byte and the **entire raw control-harness output** in all three modes. Actual mathematical mutation coverage is distinct from integrity/schema coverage. Repeated integrity/hostile replays do not add mathematical coverage. The four adapted checkers preserve all mathematical operations and remove writes; the installed-dependency adapter verifies SymPy 1.14.0 and mpmath 1.3.0 from the trusted interpreter-prefix site-packages location while requiring -I -S -B. No site hooks or environment/current-directory imports are allowed. Installed dependency code is part of the trusted runtime, not bundled or independently certified here. ## External trust anchor Authenticate the bootstrap from this externally reviewed body before running it. The bootstrap pins the entire manifest, verifier and control harness; the manifest pins every other delivered file. The manifest excludes itself and the bootstrap, avoiding self-hash circularity. Final external and held-out replay receipts remain outside the public delivery. - `BOOTSTRAP.py`: SHA-256 `6a55d39218fc77266c46aafef424127933afe54d493593c4745bc53e97cafcd4`, 2356 bytes - `PUBLICATION_MANIFEST.json`: SHA-256 `a51fbcd5c73671f0bd0a5d35ff58fe83abc71a2cdef279d31bc04062e79f904d`, 6970 bytes - `verify_publication.py`: SHA-256 `ba39260ecd9c6fd126676e377dcb95e64635d22204abd3562376432fdef3b787`, 404501 bytes - `MUTATION_TESTS.py`: SHA-256 `293dd972029b93a833915d030a85ccd003527f55ad0dd3a6ad6dbaad31471169`, 20437 bytes Copy that authenticated bootstrap outside the packet, then run `python -I -S -B EXTERNAL_BOOTSTRAP.py --controls PACKET`, also with -O and -OO, as UID/EUID1000 against read-only files/directories. Every verifier failure is a failure, not an optional skip. Base commit: `6ca1e663ab556636a3c2a9b67a96274ef95e8bab`; base tree: `a675bbb4eb340ad8a83943d490404c5f9585c0e1`. Fresh main, immutable commit/tree and exact-ref target absence were checked. Draft only; no merge or deployment requested.
